title: Preallocate query aggregate data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when query aggregate fast paths build data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added aggregate_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced COUNT prefix-count data prefix construction.
Replaced primary-key MIN/MAX key-bound data prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Query aggregate data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving count_prefix, primary-key MIN/MAX bounds, and SQL aggregate results.
